evidence.title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
evidence.bounded_claim: The reported construction disproves the conjectured n^(1+o(1)) upper growth by obtaining n^(1+delta) unit-distance pairs for infinitely many n; it does not determine the exact asymptotic of u(n).

evidence.title: The sum-product conjecture is false for real numbers
evidence.bounded_claim: The authors explicitly report that the unit-distance construction inspired renewed investigation using high-degree number fields, while describing the final proof as almost entirely human-generated.

evidence.title: Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search
evidence.bounded_claim: The preprint authors report 9 of 353 selected open Erdos problems and 44 of 492 OEIS conjectures resolved or proved using AI-driven formal proof search with Lean verification.
